subject: How should one go about development?

messages.author: 1c6d9e6319424d05
messages.subject: How should one go about development?
parts:
Hi,

I have been trying to read how to develop web applications using rapache . I am a bit confused with the different approaches that are possible. Could anyone elaborate on what is the "brew" package and how does it work . From what I have read , I found three ways to develop the website / web app :

1) Use 'sys.source'  in rapache, write plain HTML files with Http / Ajax calls to R code .R code returns back results in JSON . Update HTML accordingly.
2) Using brew (not sure how) . Embed R code in HTML using tags.
3) Using Knitr / R2HTML .(not sure how)

I may be horribly mistaken. Could anyone help me clear out my confusion with this. I mean to use just HTML and R code .( No backend code support like php/ruby/python , basically not an MVC architecture as such).

thanks,
nash

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: How should one go about development?
parts:
If you just want to write HTML and R code, I highly suggest using
brew. Scope out the test example here:

https://github.com/jeffreyhorner/rapache/blob/master/test/brew/simple.rhtml

and the apache config here (it's commented out):

https://github.com/jeffreyhorner/rapache/blob/master/test/httpd.conf.in#L113
